verdict.rationale: Hightouch's API guide says a key can be scoped to a group so it lacks admin access, and gives the example of an AI tool using a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role. This directly delivers least-privilege credentials for an agent, used as bearer tokens on the REST API. missing for 10: detailed documentation of available scope/role granularity, key expiry and rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Scope a key to a group to keep it from having admin access. For example, an AI tool can use a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role.
Authenticate each request by passing your API key as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header
Set up permissions, approvals, and ownership boundaries so each team has the right level of access.
